case_097:
broken_dry + deep_jewel + subtle_contact_shadow: real defect on two attributes — garment is flat neutral black in all 3 seeds with no jewel hue or high-value accents (4x saturation boost reveals only disagreeing undertones: navy/brown/green), and contours are continuous clean lines with no dry textured gaps; confirmed on the 1024 source, not a density limit. -- overturned at full resolution: test_id resolution: case_097 = style_id `linework_coloring_broken_dry_deep_jewel_subtle_contact_shadow_reflected_color_complete_line_color` = P7000289 (seed 1001), P7000290 (2002), P7000291 (3003). All three 1024x1024 sources inspected at native size plus 3-4x zoom crops.

BOTH attributes in the hold fail on inspection.

1) broken_dry linework — the claim ("continuous clean lines with no dry textured gaps") is directly falsified at full resolution. It only looks true because the outer silhouette is a fill boundary, not a drawn line, so the thumbnail shows a clean edge. Zooming the garment folds/hem, where the prompt actually places the gaps ("textured gaps placed away from critical anatomy"), shows broken_dry plainly expressed in all three seeds: in P7000290 the waistband line visibly breaks and restarts mid-run, sleeve fold lines taper to nothing and reappear, and stroke ends are ragged/scratchy; in P7000291 the waistband breaks and the pleat and fold strokes fade in and out as tapered discontinuous marks; P7000289's sleeve fold strokes are likewise tapered and interrupted. These gaps are a few pixels wide and vanish at contact-sheet scale — a textbook thumbnail artifact.

2) deep_jewel colour — the garment really is near-neutral and dark, but that is a cohort property of deep_jewel + reflected_color in this rig, not an item defect, which is exactly the case the screening rule excludes. The official saturation_screen.json (group_axis=coloring, deviation=0.5) reports outlier_total=0 and outlier_count=0 for deep_jewel; group median 0.1628, min 0.1107. My own recomputation puts this item at 0.1216 — 73% of its own group's median, far above the ~0.081 flag threshold, ranked 4/43. Isolating the real confound, the low tail of deep_jewel is almost entirely reflected_color (controlled_rim siblings run ~2x brighter: garment value ~92 vs ~34). Within the deep_jewel+reflected_color sub-cohort (n=21) the target's garment-region saturation is 0.1458 vs cohort median 0.1607 and chroma 4.32 vs median 5.53 — rank 6/21, with three accepted siblings lower. Accepted sibling P7000271 (broken_dry + deep_jewel + crisp_shape_shadow + reflected_color) renders essentially identically: flat neutral black garment, garment chroma 2.38 vs the target's 2.26.

The reviewer's saturation-boost evidence is self-invalidating: I reproduced it, and the "disagreeing undertones" are quantization noise in a near-black region (garment dark-tone mean chroma 2.3/255, hue circular concentration R=0.65-0.71, hue disagreeing across seeds — purple 55%, orange 95%, green 58%). The accepted sibling P7000271 shows the same incoherent purple/navy noise (R=0.67). A test whose evidence appears identically in a passing sibling cannot distinguish this item. The prompt also specifies deep jewel "separated by dark neutrals," so dark neutral mass is within spec.

Neither attribute survives full-resolution review: the linework claim is affirmatively contradicted, and the colour claim is a group-level characteristic that the saturation screen explicitly clears.

The hold said elastic_pressure was "pale grey on near-white" and needed autocontrast to see. That is false at full resolution. Tracing the jaw/neck contour on each seed gives a line luminance median of 48 / 68 / 48 against a background of ~222 / ~219 / ~223 — a near-black stroke on light ground, roughly 150-175 levels of separation, not pale grey. The pallor was a downsampling artifact: at sheet density a 1-3px dark stroke averages with the protected white ground into light grey.

Line-weight modulation is present and legible on all three seeds. Along the same traced contour the stroke runs from a 1px hairline to a ~3px median with visible swells, and in the zoomed crops the modulation is unambiguous: the jaw contour tapers to nothing at the chin and again where it meets the hair while swelling through the mid-jaw (clearest on seed 3003), the lip line is thick-thin-thick with pooled dark blobs at the mouth corners, the nose is a fine tapering stroke, and on seed 2002 the shoulder/arm contour starts thin, swells through the shoulder curve, and tapers down the sleeve while the collar line stays whisper-thin — a deliberate heavy-contour vs light-interior-line hierarchy. That is textbook elastic_pressure. All three seeds agree; no seed disagreement to adjudicate.

airy_pastel and soft_two_band read as originally noted (protected whites, mint/pink/lavender flecks, feathered two-value face band). The original concern was line weight rather than saturation, but saturation_screen.json corroborates no colour defect: the airy_pastel group (42 items, median 0.0839, range 0.0672-0.1085) reports outlier_count 0 and outlier_total 0 axis-wide, and this item is not in ungrouped_item_ids, so it sits inside its own group's normal band.
